title: δ-Mem was introduced with paper and code links
summary: On 2026-05-13, δ-Mem was presented in this development line with links to a Hugging Face Papers entry and the declare-lab/delta-Mem repository. This is a material research-release milestone because it connects the project to both a paper record and an implementation resource. The available dated links do not establish the release's technical claims, authorship, version, or evaluation results.
